value.rationale: The headcount-payment requirement interacts with effort-weighted voting: for three representatives all heterogeneous strictly positive efforts still reward sincere signal voting under a neutral prior, but at five a robust, tie-free, fully informative open set rewards anti-sincere votes. The sharp minimal committee size isolates a structural vulnerability not implied by simple correctness or computational replication; no full equilibrium is claimed.
